name: Sika AnchorFix Perforated Sleeves
paste:
SIKA ANCHORFIX® PERFORATED SLEEVES: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika AnchorFix® Perforated Sleeves, April 2023, Version 02.01 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sika_anchorfix_perforatedsleeves.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika AnchorFix® Perforated Sleeves where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01).
1.2 Product description. Perforated sleeves for use with threaded rod and starter bars with Sika Anchorfix 1 Chemical anchor in hollow masonry and hollow bricks
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer. Perforated sleeves are used for fixing of anchors into hollow masonry and hollow bricks

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika AnchorFix® Perforated Sleeves
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: AnchorFix Accessory for application in hollow bricks/masonry
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.01) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Appearance and colour: Plastic grey sleeves
2.4 Dimensions.
    | Length | Diameter |
    | 85 mm | 16 mm |
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Packing unit: Bag of 10 pieces
    - Shelf life: 5 years from date of production
    - Storage conditions: The product must be stored in original, unopened and undamaged sealed packaging in dry conditions at temperatures between +5 °C and +35 °C. Always refer to packaging.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.01) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2023, Version 02.01) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application method / tools. 1. After cleaning dust etc. from the drill hole, the perforated sleeve is placed into the drill hole. 2. Starting from the bottom of the perforated sleeve, gradually apply the Sika AnchorFix® anchoring adhesive into the sleeve so the resin squeezes out through the perforations. 3. Close the sleeve centre ring cap to avoid resin escaping before insertion of the anchor. 4. Insert the anchor into the sleeve with a rotary motion within the adhesive open time. Some of the adhesive must flow out of the end of the sleeve and through the perforations into the cavity of the hollow masonry.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2023, Version 02.01) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika AnchorFix® Perforated Sleeves, April 2023, Version 02.01, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/o/sika_anchorfix_perforatedsleeves.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety - Regulation (ec) no 1907/2006 - reach. This product is an article as defined in article 3 of regulation (EC) No 1907/2006 (REACH). It contains no substances which are intended to be released from the article under normal or reasonably foreseeable conditions of use. A safety data sheet following article 31 of the same regulation is not needed to bring the product to the market, to transport or to use it. For safe use follow the instructions given in the product data sheet. Based on our current knowledge, this product does not contain SVHC (substances of very high concern) as listed in Annex XIV of the REACH regulation or on the candidate list published by the European Chemicals Agency in concentrations above 0,1 % (w/w).
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
